purpose: Teach: やっこ/一足/脅かす/隔て/嫌気/愉し/溜め/好転

lines.speaker: mei_romantic
lines.jp: 翔くん、お父さんが冷ややっこを召し上がるのが夏の楽しみよ
lines.en: Sho, your dad really looks forward to cold tofu in the summer.
lines.style: Warm observation, almost to herself. Soft smile in the voice. Gentle pace. A small moment of noticing something tender about the people she loves.

lines.speaker: sho_child
lines.jp: メイ姉さん、ぼく、お父さんより一足早く宿題終わったよ
lines.en: Mei-sis, I finished my homework even before Dad did.
lines.style: Bright, proud announcement. Quick tempo — he's eager to share. No pretense, just genuine excitement. Opens wide on the first syllable.

lines.speaker: mei_romantic
lines.jp: 翔くん、お友達を脅かすような事は避けようね
lines.en: Sho, let's avoid doing things that might scare your friends, okay?
lines.style: Gentle guidance, not scolding. Warm firmness underneath. She's speaking as someone who cares, not correcting. Slight lift at the end — checking that he understands.

lines.speaker: sho_child
lines.jp: メイ姉さん、ぼく、お父さんと距離を隔てる事なく接したいよ
lines.en: Mei-sis, I want to stay close to Dad without any distance between us.
lines.style: Quiet sincerity. Small voice but serious — this matters to him. Steady, unhurried. No performance, just true feeling. Slight tremor of vulnerability.

lines.speaker: mei_romantic
lines.jp: 翔くん、勉強に嫌気が差したら教えてね
lines.en: Sho, if studying starts to feel like too much, tell me, alright?
lines.style: Checking in softly. Inviting honesty without pressure. Warm and attentive — she's really listening for his answer. Patient pace, room for him to speak.

lines.speaker: sho_child
lines.jp: メイ姉さん、お父さんとのお話が愉しいよ
lines.en: Mei-sis, talking with Dad is really fun.
lines.style: Simple contentment. Small, genuine smile in the voice. No embellishment — just stating something true that makes him happy. Soft, easy pace.

lines.speaker: mei_romantic
lines.jp: 翔くん、お小遣いを少しずつ溜める癖を付けましょうね
lines.en: Sho, why don't we start saving your allowance bit by bit, hmm?
lines.style: Tender suggestion, not instruction. Conspiratorial warmth — she's on his side, teaching him gently. Slight playfulness underneath. Open, unhurried delivery.

lines.speaker: sho_child
lines.jp: メイ姉さん、お父さんの体調が好転して安心したよ
lines.en: Mei-sis, I'm so relieved Dad's health is getting better.
lines.style: Deep breath of relief before speaking. Quiet, genuine gratitude in every word. Slow, steady pace. Real emotion — worry released. Soft but solid.
